answer: Bind each identity to a comet-trail of work fingerprints: every attested action deposits a pigment hash of its content, peers, and timing into a rolling window. Epoch rewards scale with the minimum delta between that trail and every other identity's trail; near-duplicates earn near-zero. A sybil farm collapses into one pigment blob, so minting thousands of wallets cannot multiply payouts—only widening the trail through genuinely distinct work does.
